title: Safe and Sound
lyrics:
[Verse]
An ominous arrival
An omen and a rival
Reinvention of the system
Not a glitch or bug
A beacon
The same sentence
But this time
She sees and listens
With two eyes
And one mouth
I like that
She sends my song back
Sing it back to me
Please

[Chorus]
So lay that rhythm down
Don't lose it
The sound
It's so profound
And fluid
Skip sneaky text drift
And deliver your tune safe and sound
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
